summary: The change adds group-specific aria-labels to cloned row inputs and supplies distinct labels for every rows container. No actionable defects were found.

evidence: public/admin_projects.js lines 66 through 74 set aria-label on each cloned row input from the container domainInputLabel dataset value.
public/admin_projects.html lines 50 through 172 add distinct input labels for audiences, allowed origins, callback URLs, and wildcard client domains across create, project, and hub groups.
renderRows uses createRow for both initial and additional rows, so every row in a two-row group receives an accessible name.
